name: AR_BPA_DELIVERY_DETAILS
description: The AR_BPA_DELIVERY_DETAILS stores information that is used for delivering printed transactions via e-mail.

columns.name: DELIVERY_DETAILS_ID
columns.description: A unique sequence number generated for the delivery details of the printed transaction.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer Receivables transaction.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Payment schedule identifier for the transaction.

columns.name: DELIVERY_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method used to deliver printed transactions. Valid values are E-mail, Standard, and XML.

columns.name: CONTACT_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: E-Mail address of the customer bill-to contact  who receives printed transactions.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Receivables transaction to be printed.

columns.name: TERMS_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Installment number to be printed of the payment schedule on the transaction.

columns.name: REPLY_TO_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Reply-to e-mail address for printed transactions delivered using e-mail.

columns.name: FROM_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: From e-mail address for printed transactions delivered using e-mail.

columns.name: EMAIL_SUBJECT
columns.description: E-Mail subject line for printed transactions delivered using e-mail.

columns.name: EMAIL_BODY
columns.description: Body of the e-mail for printed transactions delivered using e-mail.

columns.name: FROM_EMAIL_NAME
columns.description: Name of the from e-mail address for printed transactions delivered using e-mail.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Extracted document identifier

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONS_BILLING_NUMBER
columns.description: Consolidated billing invoice number.

columns.name: BILLING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request ID of the job that generated the BIP report.
